g.text: Offline TAR inventory — streaming metadata, mock-only completion
first START; total120s, work119s, cleanup reserve1s
capture strict own-data limits and mock protocol
Mock markers assert a test protocol only.
this module is not a capability sandbox.
No filesystem, network or child adapter.
[One pull at a time; no next pull until sink work finishes]
bounded native byte chunk or mock completion
parse headers / extensions / member bytes / padding
Octal digits must precede any NUL terminator
PAX local/global and GNU longname/link subset
Unknown keys, sparse layouts and kinds STOP
canonical path collision checks; bounded metadata digest
frozen provisional events; no member contents
require explicit mock integrity and compressed-EOF flags
accepted terminal receipt closes mock source contract
finish(): require complete framing and no pending member/extension
All expanded bytes and serialized metadata count.
Link targets are data and never followed.
Events stay provisional until all gates pass.
[All parser, mock completion and sink gates pass]
[Parse, source, sink, limit or deadline failure]
absorb failure; no more pulls, parsing, sink work or success
[Acquired source without accepted completion and budget remains]
captured return at most once; bounded wait
cleanup error supersedes first failure with cause
throw failure; ignore handled late promise results
Additive createTarMemberInventory shares this state machine and exposes final regular-file spans.
Span JSON<=4MiB; offsets count consumed physical bytes after GNU/PAX header processing.
Base feed events, metadata digests and existing summary schema remain unchanged.
Parser/controller source and tests are synthetic offline infrastructure, not an XZ decoder.
No archive read/stat/list, extraction, process, tool discovery or network belongs in this unit.
Expanded<=1GiB; physical headers<=65536; total extension payload<=64KiB.
Event<=32768 bytes; total metadata<=16MiB; retained collision keys<=32MiB.
Limits constrain source-accounted work, not native heap, callbacks or hard CPU/time containment.
Mock next results are own-data done/value records; success receipts contain exactly three true flags.
Valid mock completion closes its source contract even when later TAR finalization fails.
Metadata SHA-256 binds ordered UTF-8 JSON events + LF, not discarded payload bytes.
Real XZ framing/integrity, decoder qualification, SDK NoPython and Rust verification remain separate.
